4.2
Initial Screening
All IRs will go through a set of screenings before they can enter the DPP, or other planning
processes defined in the GIP. This screening will include verifying the application submitted has
the required date information, technical information, met the necessary Milestones, and study


deposits, etc. For IRs submitted for entry into the DPP all original Commercial Operation Dates
shall be no more than five (5) years beyond the MISO Transmission Expansion Planning (MTEP)
model year in effect for the active Queue cycle. The original Commercial Operation Date and
original In-Service Date set forth in the verified IR upon entering the DPP shall be considered as
the dates in the original IR for the purpose of applying requirements in Tariff Attachment X, Section
4.4.4.
